fieldValues.title: Every decision names the boundary where it removes choices; domains are sensed from the boundaries that recur
fieldValues.move: When a decision is proposed, applied or found, its record names the level and boundary where it removes choices: a link to the domain when one exists, otherwise a boundary:<slug> tag in plain words. A session or desk shows a decision only at its level; elsewhere it is context. Boundary tags are counted; one that keeps recurring is brought to affirmation review as a candidate domain, and two domains whose decisions keep crossing are proposed for merging. No domain is created up front to make a decision placeable.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not decide who owns each level (decision 949ae72d does), nor recover the placement of the 109 existing decisions; those are placed as they are next cited.
fieldValues.falsifier: After a month, boundary tags have not converged (each decision names a new one), or the owner's sessions still receive design-kind decisions.
source_ref: Finding: no decision records the level or boundary where it removes choices (2026-10-28)
